title.v: Báo cáo kết quả sản xuất kinh doanh tổng hợp

action.text: declare @tk_no varchar(256), @tk_co varchar(256), @data varchar(4000), @giam_tru tinyint, @tk_kqkd varchar(256), @ma_dvcs varchar(1024), @ma_kh varchar(1024) declare @ngay1 smalldatetime, @ngay2 smalldatetime, @dateFrom0 smalldatetime, @dateTo0 smalldatetime, @datePreviousBegin0 smalldatetime, @datePreviousEnd0 smalldatetime select top 1 @ma_dvcs = rtrim(ma_dvcs), @ma_kh = ma_kh, @tk_no = rtrim(tk_no), @tk_co = rtrim(tk_co), @giam_tru = giam_tru from v30gltcth2 where form = @form and ma_so = @ma_so select @tk_kqkd = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_tk_kqkd' select @dateFrom0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@ky_nay_tu), @dateTo0 = @ky_nay_den, @datePreviousBegin0 = dbo.ff_BgDate(@ky_truoc_tu), @datePreviousEnd0 = @ky_truoc_den select @ngay1 = case when @cot_dl = 1 then @ky_nay_tu when @cot_dl = 2 then @ky_truoc_tu when @cot_dl = 3 then @dateFrom0 when @cot_dl = 4 then @datePreviousBegin0 end, @ngay2 = case when @cot_dl = 1 then @ky_nay_den when @cot_dl = 2 then @ky_truoc_den when @cot_dl = 3 then @dateTo0 when @cot_dl = 4 then @datePreviousEnd0 end if @tk_no <> '' begin select @data = @tk_no, @tk_no = '' select @tk_no = @tk_no + case when @tk_no <> '' then ', ' else '' end + ltrim(rtrim(data)) from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@data, ',') order by id end if @tk_co <> '' begin select @data = @tk_co, @tk_co = '' select @tk_co = @tk_co + case when @tk_co <> '' then ', ' else '' end + ltrim(rtrim(data)) from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@data, ',') order by id end if @ma_dvcs <> '' begin select @data = @ma_dvcs, @ma_dvcs = '' select @ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs + case when @ma_dvcs <> '' then ', ' else '' end + ltrim(rtrim(data)) from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@data, ',') order by id end if @ma_kh <> '' begin select @data = @ma_kh, @ma_kh = '' select @ma_kh = @ma_kh + case when @ma_kh <> '' then ', ' else '' end + ltrim(rtrim(data)) from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@data, ',') order by id end select @tk_no as c1, @tk_co as c2, case when @giam_tru = 1 then @tk_kqkd else '' end as tk_0gt, @ngay1 as ngay1, @ngay2 as ngay2, @ma_dvcs as c5, @ma_kh as c6, @nh_vv1 as nh_vv1 return
